entities.name: Nemanja Šarović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nemanja Šarović is a Serbian politician and journalist. He served several terms in the National Assembly as a member of the far-right Serbian Radical Party (SRS). Šarović left the Radicals in July 2020 and is now the leader of the Love, Faith, Hope (LJVN) political organization. He is also a journalist for KTV Television and is known for his satirical coverage of the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) rallies.
